title: Miragon BPMN Modeler deployment targets
description: Named, team-shareable deployment connections. Secrets are never stored here.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editors without a registered mapping.

endpoint.patternErrorMessage: Every ${env:…} must reference a MIRAGON_-prefixed variable, e.g. ${env:MIRAGON_URL}; literal text may not contain "${env:".
endpoint.description: Base URL of the Camunda REST API. May contain ${env:MIRAGON_NAME} references, resolved at request time from the .env beside this file's config folder.
